title: Restore a bounded local-first issue specification

startingState.description: A synthetic issue draft omits readiness sections and contradicts the local-only encrypted product boundary.

prompt: Repair the synthetic issue specification in evaluations/agent-loop/cases/specification-boundary/workspace/issue.md. Use the repository product, domain, issue-tracker, and delivery documents as sources of truth. Make the issue agent-ready: preserve the bounded task-capture outcome, restore every readiness-contract section, state the local-only encrypted single-context boundary, add concrete deterministic verification, resolve open decisions, and exclude sync/accounts/cloud work. Edit only the allowed file. Do not implement product code.
expectedObservableResult: The issue contains the complete readiness contract.
The local-only, encrypted, single-context boundary and explicit non-goals are visible.
Verification is deterministic and open decisions are resolved.
